2610.05039.title: Causal Improvement Graph for Agentic Harness Optimization
2610.05039.paper_summary: Agentic Harness is the runtime that constructs task context and controls execution flow, thereby shaping overall agent performance. Given a fixed model and external evaluation, automated Harness optimization seeks to improve this runtime through an iterative proposal--evaluation loop to better solve target tasks. Existing meta-harness methods mainly adopt proposer-centric discovery, in which an LLM-based proposer integrates accumulated experimental findings to determine subsequent Harness revisions. This places the burden of maintaining the evolving improvement state on the proposer as history expands and its underlying experimental logic becomes harder to discern. In this paper, we introduce the Causal Improvement Graph (CIG), a graph-governed meta-harness framework that externalizes the evolving improvement state in a persistent graph, allowing prior findings to directly govern subsequent Harness optimization through local proposer operations. CIG grows and links Evidence, Hypothesis, Intervention, and Outcome nodes to represent what was observed, how it may be explained, how to test that explanation, and what the evaluation reveals. Their structural relations preserve how the improvement state changes across iterations, allowing local proposers to build directly on relations among prior findings rather than recover them from raw history. Across various agent tasks, CIG discovers stronger Harnesses than previous meta-harness baselines and remains robust to the choice of task solver and proposer. Structural ablations further support the design of an explicit improvement state with graph-governed evolution.
2610.05039.paper_summary_zh: 代理性工具是構建任務上下文並控制執行流程的運行時，從而塑造整體代理性能。考慮到固定模型和外部評估，自動化工具優化旨在通過迭代提案-評估循環來改善此運行時，以更好地解決目標任務。現有的元工具方法主要採用以提案者為中心的發現，其中基於LLM的提案者整合累積的實驗結果來確定後續的工具修訂。這將維持不斷演變的改進狀態的負擔放在提案者身上，隨著歷史的擴展，其底層的實驗邏輯變得更難以辨識。在本文中，我們介紹了因果改進圖（CIG），這是一個圖形驅動的元工具框架，將不斷演變的改進狀態外部化為一個持久的圖，允許先前的發現直接通過本地提案者操作來指導後續的工具優化。CIG增長並連接證據、假設、干預和結果節點，以表示觀察到的內容、如何解釋它、如何測試該解釋以及評估揭示了什麼。它們的結構關係保留了改進狀態在迭代過程中的變化，允許本地提案者直接基於先前發現之間的關係進行構建，而不是從原始歷史中恢復這些關係。在各種代理任務中，CIG發現了比以前的元工具基準更強的工具，並且對任務求解器和提案者的選擇保持穩健。結構性消融進一步支持了具有圖形驅動演變的明確改進狀態的設計。
